mentions.name: Winter '78
mentions.description: This is a prototype of a terminal-centric BBS-like system accessed over SSH, inspired by the Spring '83 protocol but designed for the terminal rather than the web.
mentions.source_excerpt: Prototyping a cute little SSH-based sorta-BBS, inspired by the Spring '83 protocol, but terminal-centric rather than web-based. It's called Winter '78
